new_value: {"notes":"Confirmed and mechanism established. prost-build 0.14.4's protoc_from_env() falls back to the bare string 'protoc' and spawns it from PATH; tonic-prost-build 0.14 vendors no binary (grep protoc Cargo.lock returns nothing). Neither ubuntu-24.04 nor macos-15 ships protoc, and no job installs it. Because build scripts also run under cargo clippy, this surfaces at the clippy step and will read like a clippy failure. Affects check on BOTH OSes plus the msrv job. Fix: arduino/setup-protoc@v3 before the first cargo step in each job.","priority":1}
